facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; EU rules ban restrictions on payments.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes, but terms vary by bank; check each bank's currency accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Open activity with Finanças using your NIF, then register with Social Security separately.
facts.L2_tax_id: NIF, from the Tax and Customs Authority, needed before opening activity.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 12.5–48%, plus 21.4% social security on 70% of service income.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 23% VAT; exempt if last year's turnover was under €15,000.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can withdraw within 14 days.
facts.L7_incentives: No VAT under €15,000, and no Social Security for your first 12 months.

watch_out.text: Social Security registration isn't automatic; do it in Segurança Social Direta.
